note: Expected profile detection (plan §5 WP3.1, AD-11), read by src/lib/core/profiles/detect.test.ts.
One file per folder under tests/fixtures/nc (M6 P6 item 11): a content work package adds its own
fixtures and its own expectations without touching anybody else's, and a reviewer reads one dialect
at a time. The test globs this folder, so a new file needs no code change.
A value is a profile id, or 'fallback' when the content is inconclusive and the current profile stays,
or 'refused' when decodeFile does not open the file at all, so detection never runs.
M6/WP6.2 adds 'variants': the G-code system the machine parameter 'gcodeSystem' answers with when no
machine is chosen (§8.1, AD-31). 'detected' is false when the margin between the two choices stays
below 3, and the variant's default (A) applies. A variant pattern scores its weight once, however
many lines match it, which is what l07-system-b-drill.nc is here to prove.
src/lib/data/profiles/fanucLathe.test.ts reads both tables and prints the margins for gate G10.
